stories.title: Controversy swirls around the UFC event on the White House lawn this weekend
stories.summary: President Trump is hosting a UFC fight on the White House lawn on his birthday.

stories.title: You might find 'Disclosure Day' preposterous — but still preposterously entertaining
stories.summary: Steven Spielberg, who made what are arguably the two preeminent films about alien encounters, returns to that well of inspiration in his newest sci-fi wonderment, Disclosure Day.

stories.title: Ebola response is shaped by conflict in Democratic Republic of Congo
stories.summary: The Ebola outbreak is taking place in a region that has been through decades of deadly conflict. That's affecting how responders are doing their work, from testing to treating patients.

stories.title: Meet a 93-year-old member of the Tartan Army of Scotland soccer fans
stories.summary: It's Scotland's first World Cup in nearly 30 years. Moira Brown, perhaps the oldest of Scotland's Tartan Army of soccer fans, will be in Boston when Scotland's team plays against Haiti on June 13.

stories.title: The U.S. Men's National Team's moment is here
stories.summary: For the U.S. men's national soccer team, this day has been circled on the calendar for almost a decade: The most talented generation in team history is in its prime for a FIFA World Cup on home soil. Can they pull off the unthinkable?

stories.title: Irish ultra-cyclist Joe Barr nears the end of a 2,000-mile trek along Route 66
stories.summary: Irish ultra-cyclist Joe Barr is riding the entirety of Route 66 by bike, in honor of the highway's centennial. He's expected to complete his journey Friday.
